quote:
The best remake ever: true and genuine to the original, great working at making it modern with new little details in gameplay.
The story is always the same, with improvements due to extra scenes and dialogues.

author: WiwWiw
quote: Not a real GTA. Has bugs at launch, it's stuck at 30fps, the story's not that deep, you're basically forced to romance the MCs, the free will is limited compared to the old games. 13 years and all the hype for what?
